decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using powerful cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms, while ramping up mana with Cloudpost and Tron lands. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as removal spells like Kozilek's Command. The One Ring serves as a finisher, and cards like Portent of Calamity and Sink into Stupor help maintain board control. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through resource management and powerful threats.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly combo off using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, then use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle and win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm. Urza's Saga can help find key pieces, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Loki, God of Mischief provide additional card advantage and control. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Voice of Victory, Sand Scout, and Ocelot Pride to apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another layer of versatility to the deck. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan, with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah providing additional removal and combat tricks. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and consistent aggro strategy.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent while quickly putting pressure on them with efficient creatures and spells. The deck utilizes powerful disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while using cards like Brazen Borrower and Moonshadow to apply pressure and finish the game quickly. Mishra's Bauble is included to help with card selection and to trigger Nethergoyf's ability. The deck also includes land destruction spells like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The key concept of this Bant Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through card advantage and powerful creatures. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells, removal, and card draw, while also utilizing cards like Leyline Binding to lock down opposing threats. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo and Quantum Riddler provides additional card advantage and flexibility, while Phelia and Murktide Regent serve as win conditions. The manabase is carefully crafted to provide consistent access to all necessary colors of mana.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through countering opponent's spells and removal while steadily building up tempo. By utilizing cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with creatures like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Murktide Regent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for answers and maintain card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining control over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, supported by powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand while utilizing Goblin Bombardment for additional reach. The mana base is carefully constructed with lands like Arid Mesa and Wasteland to ensure consistency and access to all necessary colors. Finally, cards like Swords to Plowshares and Static Prison provide removal and protection against opposing threats.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Council's Judgment, while using cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm to generate card advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats and answers. The deck also utilizes disruptive creatures like Quantum Riddler and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to further disrupt the opponent's plans and maintain control of the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes a variety of lands that can be used for different purposes, such as removing threats, accelerating mana, or locking down the opponent's resources. The deck also includes cards like Crop Rotation and Life from the Loam to search for and reuse key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. By effectively managing its lands and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to establish dominance and secure victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while rapidly deploying threats to pressure them. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the game and protect its own threats. Cards like Fatal Push and Nethergoyf provide efficient removal and powerful creatures to apply pressure. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student acts as a versatile card draw engine, while Kaito, Bane of Nightmares adds a finisher to close out games. The deck aims to maintain a balance of disruption, tempo, and aggression to dominate the field.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan using a variety of counterspells and removal spells. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and card selection to ensure consistency in drawing powerful spells. The win condition involves playing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and using additional tools like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler to close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the diverse range of spells in the deck while also providing access to various colors of mana.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hand disruption and counterspells while quickly deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to apply pressure. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility, while cards like Fatal Push and Brainstorm help control the board. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace, using Wasteland to disrupt opponents' mana bases and control the game until it can close out with its efficient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cards, including Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and a variety of fetch lands and control spells, to create a powerful win condition. By efficiently searching for key cards with Doomsday and controlling the opponent's actions with Force of Will and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to set up a winning combo with Thassa's Oracle. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Lion's Eye Diamond add flexibility and resilience to the strategy, allowing for multiple avenues to victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the board with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to deploy powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms to dominate the game. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Kozilek's Command also provide additional utility and game-winning potential. With a focus on controlling the opponent's actions and building up resources, this deck aims to overpower the opponent with overwhelming threats and resource advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards such as Faithless Looting, Unmask, and Cabal Therapy, then reanimate them onto the battlefield with Animate Dead, Shallow Grave, or Reanimate. Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal provide mana acceleration to help cast these spells early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. Key cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor provide strong threats, while Swords to Plowshares and Static Prison help control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and consistency. The strategy revolves around applying early pressure, using removal to clear the way, and maintaining board dominance to secure victory. Through a combination of speed and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.
